review.summary: The plan references several modules, services, and data models that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json or repo files.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: shared authorization middleware
findings.evidence: The plan mentions 'shared authorization middleware' without evidence of its existence in the current repo.
findings.requiredAction: Define and implement 'shared authorization middleware' before proceeding.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: correlation ID propagation
findings.evidence: The plan discusses 'correlation ID propagation through UI -> edge -> DB -> inference' without evidence of these components.
findings.requiredAction: Define and implement the necessary components for correlation ID propagation before proceeding.

findings.title: Ungrounded service reference: unified release runbooks
findings.evidence: The plan refers to 'unified release runbooks' without evidence of their existence in the current repo.
findings.requiredAction: Define and implement 'unified release runbooks' before proceeding.

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
